description: This file defines the core class FooTable.Table for a table plugin, including initialization, event handling, component management, and drawing logic.

classes.name: FooTable.Table
classes.description: Core class of the FooTable plugin managing table initialization, rendering, event handling, and component execution.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FooTable.Table instance with element, options, and optional ready callback.

methods.name: _construct
methods.description: Performs the actual initialization sequence, including preinit, init, and event raising.

methods.name: _preinit
methods.description: Pre-initialization step to parse options and prepare the table before full initialization.

methods.description: Initializes the table, sets up DOM structure, and prepares for drawing.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the table plugin instance, removing event handlers and data.

methods.description: Raises an event on the table instance, optionally with additional arguments.

methods.description: Retrieves a specific component instance associated with this table.

methods.name: draw
